notes: Email thread with executive-level disagreements. Tests that conflicts become decisions to make, not silent picks.
input:
Re: pricing page — collecting everyone's input

CEO: The free plan must stay free forever with unlimited projects — that's our growth engine.
CFO: Free users should be capped at 3 projects so they upgrade.
CEO: Annual plans get 20% off.
Head of Sales: Enterprise deals often need 30% off annual, so let's make the discount 30% for everyone.
CFO: Users can cancel anytime and get a prorated refund.
Legal: Annual plans are non-refundable after 14 days.

requirements: paid plans with an upgrade path
conflicts: unlimited projects on the free plan vs a cap of 3 projects
prorated refund on cancellation vs annual plans non-refundable after 14 days
